## Exact Parent Object

The only base parent class is one complete atomic JINC observation bundle for
one observation, stable array, exact JINC plan/realization, target WCS, and
lifecycle generation. Its five required numerical roles are exactly:

1. `jinc_signal_numerator`;
2. `jinc_signed_normalization`;
3. `jinc_quadratic_accumulator`;
4. `jinc_map`; and
5. `jinc_coefficient_squared_time`.

The parent also binds exact PTC product/application and coefficient generation,
same-processed-sample AST association, stable RTC `n`, detector UID,
array/group, signed-kernel parameter state, grouping, local support/validity,
causes, completion/failure, and compact generative provenance. Failure to form
any required role suppresses the complete bundle; pixel-local invalid support
is ordinary bundle content.

Base JINC authorizes no cross-observation coadd, response companion, covariance
product, physical exposure, empirical weight, or significance product. NOI
cannot supply those missing JINC roles retroactively.

## NOI Uses And Immutable Parentage

The realized-JINC GEN route has complete candidate method identity
`NOI-GEN/REALIZED-JINC-CONDITIONAL-SIGN@1`. It randomizes an exact realized
complete JINC bundle at the method's declared insertion point. It is distinct
from randomizing PTC occurrences before a frozen JINC operator, even if an
output happens to be numerically equal. ODQ-102A selects the separate
PTC-to-frozen-MAP route, not this realized-JINC route. This route remains
unselected and unavailable.

- GEN may use only an exact realized complete JINC bundle or a separately
  authorized earlier insertion route with a complete DAG. No ordinary MAP
  coadd or realization rule is imported by analogy.
- UNC may attach a versioned empirical uncertainty companion to the exact JINC
  parent or declared ensemble. It cannot relabel
  `jinc_quadratic_accumulator`, `jinc_signed_normalization`, or
  `jinc_coefficient_squared_time` as variance, precision, exposure, or weight.
- STD may use `jinc_map` as numerator only when the complete parent exists and
  an exact compatible positive signal-unit UNC scale is authorized. It does
  not alter JINC local support or create a JINC response/covariance product.

## Current Numerical Availability

Frozen JINC r0.3 is conditional and presently authorizes no numerical TolTEC
JINC bundle. A numerical route requires, at minimum:

- a registered, selected, realized JINC-permitted PTC coefficient
  family/value/QC state;
- an owner-authorized TolTEC array parameter set; and
- where numerical support is claimed, an exact numerical-adequacy profile and
  matching realization certificate.

Absent any of these, the numerical parent is typed unavailable. This boundary
does not import a MAP coefficient, hidden parameter/default, ordinary MAP
permission, response, covariance, exposure, or approximate certificate.

The realized-JINC GEN route remains unavailable as an unselected,
scientifically incomplete route independently of parent availability.

## Fail-Closed Compatibility

Missing or conflicting observation, stable array, plan/realization, WCS,
product-role, lifecycle, PTC/AST association, coefficient, parameter,
admission, support, validity, completion, or provenance identity makes the NOI
route unavailable. A partial five-role bundle is not a parent. Later NOI
companions preserve the exact JINC parent and claims without mutation.

This boundary establishes no implementation conformity, numerical adequacy,
empirical calibration, physical-noise validity, significance, performance,
readiness, or production authorization.
